events.detail: Founded seed 260918 at hall (76, 188), shard (157, 156), rivals 3.
A Settlement Begins
Storehouse completed.
First night began on day 1.
Raid active with 2 enemies.
THE SHARD LIES NE — a frontier marker is within reach.
A rival Claimant Outpost has been sighted on the frontier.
CLAIMANT OUTPOST CAPTURED — their stores are yours. +8 Wood, +4 Stone, +2 Wyrd. Hold the corridor; the rival will return.
Raw Wyrd exposure is rising. Raise a Lumen on the harvester or refine the surplus.
The harvester drinks the first raw Wyrd.
RIVAL PUSH — they raise another Outpost on the fissure.
The refiner yields the first Stabilized Wyrd.
HARVESTER RAID — hostiles from the west mean the Wyrd vent.
HARVESTER RAID — the rival strikes the Wyrd vent.
6 STABILIZED — choose faster refining, or invest 3 to secure the harvester.
6 STABILIZED — choose faster refining, or invest 3 to secure the harvester.
SECURE HARVEST — 3 Stabilized ward the vent. Raids lose their teeth.
Store reached 12 Stabilized Wyrd.
SEAL BEGUN — defend the fissure ceremony for 120 seconds.
THE FISSURE IS SEALED — the ceremony held.
